name: Shadcn UI Kit
summary: Shadcn/ui kit of admin dashboards, 555 blocks, components, illustrations and Next.js templates, installed via a shadcn registry.
description: A kit by Bundui built on shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, React and Next.js: 16 admin dashboards, 17 web app templates, 555 blocks, 700+ components and examples, and animated UI illustrations. Every item has a shadcn registry name for CLI install or copy-paste, plus a Page Builder, Theme Generator and MCP server. One-time payment with lifetime updates, alongside a free Starter tier.
contains: 936 shadcn registry items (932 code items measured)
555 blocks: heroes, pricing, testimonials, navbars, footers, stats, charts, tables, kanban, chat, maps
16 admin dashboards, 17 web app templates, 40+ extra pages, 700+ components and examples
tools: Page Builder, Theme Generator, MCP server
components work with both Radix UI and Base UI
built with Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4; some templates use Astro
one-time payment with lifetime updates; free Starter items
